verdict.rationale: Ghostty documents a built-in AppleScript dictionary for scripting windows, tabs, terminals, layouts and input events, plus Apple Shortcuts (AppIntents) support. This is a first-party automation interface covering opening windows and sending input, but it is macOS-only. Elsewhere the evidence shows only launch-time CLI flags, `+show-config`, and systemd single-instance new-window integration on Linux. missing for 10: a cross-platform documented CLI/IPC control interface (e.g. a remote-control socket), explicit evidence of querying terminal state, Linux scripting beyond opening windows, and independent hands-on corroboration.
